scenarios.name: The Split Passage
scenarios.subtitle: Floor 01 broken ring: the split passage and the light beyond stone
scenarios.purpose: A 1152 px scrolling hall in local coordinates (R2 and R3 of the Broken Ring, KR1). One continuous ground lane. Platform 0 is the 64 px overhead route of the fork: 384 px long, it rejoins the ground lane at its far end, well inside one 640 px screen. Platform 1 is the R3 view ledge, 64 px (at most 80, KR10), so both heroes see the camp together.
scenarios.expected: Spawns, zones and the roster come from f01_ring_split.encounter.json; this file holds geometry only. The ceiling is the DP-Q45 soffit at 228 px above the walking line (KR9).
scenarios.coop: Solo with a swap, or two players: both routes and the view ledge are Carl's class; nothing here is Donut-only.
